external_sources.name: Corvaja–Zannier, A subspace theorem approach to integral points on curves
external_sources.scope: Theorem 1 and S-integral extension, pp.268–269, primary statement inspected; Siegel input to fixed-curve avoidance, not locally formalized.

external_sources.name: Corvaja–Zannier, On integral points on surfaces
external_sources.scope: Introduction and stated Siegel theorem inspected; the stronger surface theorem is not used.

external_sources.name: Zheng Xiao, Greatest common divisors for polynomials in almost units, arXiv v3
external_sources.scope: Definitions 1.2 and 2.2, Theorem 1.3; primary theorem and all-place gcd convention inspected. Optional Theorem1.4 explicit consequence separately proved in renewal review. Not formalized.

external_sources.name: Kunrui Yu, Linear forms in p-adic logarithms III
external_sources.scope: Rational corollary pp.244–245; original typeset p.245 visually inspected by root and two reviewers, including A=A_(n-1) condition. Not formalized.

external_sources.name: N. M. Korobov, On the distribution of digits in periodic fractions
external_sources.scope: Theorem4 pp.671–674, fixed base and prime; permanent primary PDF opened. Conservative positive constant is sufficient. Not formalized.

external_sources.name: Joseph Vandehey, Differencing methods for Korobov-type exponential sums
external_sources.scope: Theorem2.4 p.5, independent primary restatement of the prime-power estimate and hypotheses; no precise numerical constant claimed in current application.

external_sources.name: Paul Vojta, Nevanlinna theory and Diophantine approximation
external_sources.scope: Theorem7.6, especially linear independence over the moving field and slow heights; inspected to locate the full-cycle obstruction, not imported as a closing theorem.

external_sources.name: Halbeisen–Hungerbühler, Optimal bounds for the length of rational Collatz cycles
external_sources.scope: Classical rational-cycle formulas, compared in arithmetic note; finite formulas also rederived directly.

external_sources.name: Caravenna–Doney, Local large deviations and the strong renewal theorem
external_sources.scope: Comparison only: present central-mass proof uses elementary integrated renewal estimates, not the pointwise strong renewal theorem.

external_sources.name: Sara Brofferio, The Poisson boundary of random rational affinities
external_sources.scope: First-moment requirement compared to true marked law with infinite mean; no closing consequence imported.

external_sources.name: Weaver, papers 37 v4 and 127 v1
external_sources.scope: Source-qualified single-arm inverse statements; do not furnish completed paired marks. Named floor hypotheses retained in late PR201 comparison.

external_sources.name: Weaver and fourier_wren, paper48 v2
external_sources.scope: Named linear-extra-depth floor F in PR203; used only conditionally in the late head composition, not an unconditional closing input.
